title: Spider bite leads Fox to one of the girls

tellings.quote: incident." He goes, "Oh my gosh, I dated one of the girls."

plain: James Fox, who presents himself as a witness to his own investigation, says that around 2012 in Varginha, a town in Brazil, a spider bite led him to meet a man who told him, "Oh my gosh, I dated one of the girls." The girls were central to a reported incident in Varginha in which, as it is told, the army captured a live alien. Fox tells it as the lucky break that brought him closer to the original witnesses.
